program: composition_search Cycle 1b - Track W (sleeve-level + within-sleeve weighting methodology comparison)
registration_rule: Grid below is FROZEN. No addition/deletion after any measurement starts. All trials measured and reported in full (including failures). Any deviation must be logged as protocol violation, not silently absorbed.

honesty_frame.prior_evidence: Prior weighting-axis sweep (HRP/RMT/copula/CVaR/NCO/MaxDiv/robustMV/Kelly/minvar; 9 trials) all <= EW with OOS -0.5~-0.8, BUT measured on val_rd_wc top-25 substrate later graded F (2026-06-11 pre-winsorize artifact).
honesty_frame.this_experiment: INV-7 re-trial of the weighting axis on VALIDATED substrates. First measurement of low-turnover weighting benefit under cost model v2.4 delta (flat model overstated cost for low-TO methods by up to 3x at TO<3x/yr, b0_fee_bug_report).
honesty_frame.negative_outcome_value: If EW wins again on clean substrates, the weighting axis is cleanly closed (mode-local axiom candidate). That is a valid, valuable result.

selection_protocol.is_window_selection: common_start ~ 2018-12 (IS-only selection: argmax IS net SR, tie-break IS PORT_t_nw_lag3)
selection_protocol.oos_window_confirmation: 2019-01 ~ data end. OOS used ONLY for non-degradation confirmation (OOS delta-SR vs EW >= 0). OOS argmax FORBIDDEN.
selection_protocol.dsr_gate: DSR >= 0.5 HARD applies (explicit sweep). n_trials counted in full below.
selection_protocol.n_trials_cumulative_note: 77 (this prereg) + 9 (prior 2026-06 weighting sweep on invalidated val_rd_wc substrate - counted because same question family despite F-grade substrate)

cost_model: v2.4_kr_retail_15bps (delta-based, per-name |delta holding| charged; harness default since 2026-06-11 flip). Any comparison to historical flat-cost records must be labeled.

constraints.liquidity: 20d ADV >= 2e8 KRW, t-1 PIT (C10), harness standard filter
constraints.no_overlay: No VT/DD/regime exposure overlay in any trial - weighting axis isolated. Substrate score panels regenerated as-is (incl. any PIT t-1 regime_scale inside the signal), but simulation runs without vol_target/soft exposure layers.

substrates.selection_rationale: Within-sleeve substrates must be SIGNAL-defined (weighting axis free), not weighting-defined. Registry SR>0.8 cluster top entries STR_1439/1047/1033/1435/1028/1562 are excluded as substrates because their identity IS an allocation scheme (gerber-HRP/NCO/multi-sleeve) - circular. Chosen: production-book signal (S1) + two signal-pure grade-A registry modules from distinct signal families (S2, S3).

source: 04_Research/pg2_forensics/intermediate/variant_top20_selections.csv (monthly top-20 lists incl. blend_65_35, PIT-verified b1 section 0)
S1.fidelity: reconstruction vs production sleeve scores: core spearman 0.965 / defense 0.989 (b1_summary.md)
S1.label_note: metric_type=backtested on reconstruction substrate; production ret_orig remains the authoritative book series. All deltas are vs this substrate's own EW baseline, NOT vs production.

S2.source: 04_Research/strategies/STR_943_oc_eps_chg/run_all.R - regenerate FACTORS(Date,Ticker,Score) panel (rank composite: ivol + operating-cashflow + EPS chg 1m/3m, sector-demeaned)
S2.rationale: Highest-SR signal-pure module in SR>=0.8 cluster; weight_method axis fully free (original uses weight_method='equal'); longest history covering entire IS window.

S3.registry: module_performance.json full_sharpe 1.329 / IR 1.266 (highest IR in grade-A cluster) / grade A / 2005-02~2026-03 (metric_type=backtested_realized)
S3.source: 04_Research/strategies/STR_1550_consensus_core_alpha/run_all.R - regenerate FACTORS panel (consensus core alpha family - distinct signal family from S2)
S3.top_n_note: Original uses n_holdings=30 + buffer_zone; capped to 25 per immutable max-names constraint. EW baseline re-measured at 25 on same engine - registry 1.329 NOT comparable, all deltas internal.

B.b1_motivation: b1 section 5: uncovered design areas of production = defense internal weighting and the FIXED 65/35 sleeve ratio. blend vs core_only: dSR +0.070 / dMDD -4.4pp (proxy, b1).

list.name: EW (BASELINE)
list.mechanism: Maximum breadth, zero estimation error - the incumbent that beat all prior challengers.

list.name: score-tilt lambda=1.5
list.mechanism: Production Iter31 lambda - replicates the live book's chosen tilt strength.

list.name: inverse-vol
list.mechanism: Per-name vol equalization - low-vol tilt + dispersion stabilization.

list.name: ERC
list.mechanism: Equal risk contribution with full covariance - balances risk beyond the diagonal.

list.name: min-var
list.mechanism: Variance minimization / beta compression - candidate MDD lever under long-only.

list.name: vol-scaled EW
list.definition: w_i propto (1/N)*clamp(sigma_med/sigma_i, 0.5, 1.5), renormalize; sigma_i = 252d rolling vol, sigma_med = cross-sectional median
list.mechanism: Damped half-step between EW and inverse-vol - robust to vol estimation noise.

hrp_grid.mandate: Dohoon directive 2026-06-11: HRP performance is highly sensitive to covariance estimator and allocation scheme - structured 4-axis grid, NO full cross (one-axis-at-a-time around anchor).

anchor.spec: sample cov + single linkage + Lopez de Prado (2016) recursive bisection + 36m (756d) rolling window
anchor.mechanism: Original paper spec - inversion-free hierarchical diversification.
anchor.honesty_note: In-house calc_hrp_weights hardcodes ward.D2 linkage and n_days=120 - anchor itself requires the pre-registered parameter exposure (see code_change_allowlist).

axis_A_covariance_one_at_a_time.mechanism: Shrinks sample noise in small-sample top-N covariances toward scaled identity.
Threshold co-movement - robust to noise and non-normality.
Averages noise-band eigenvalues, keeps signal eigenmodes.

axis_B_linkage_one_at_a_time.mechanism: Balanced cluster sizes - stabilizes bisection splits.

axis_C_allocation_one_at_a_time.mechanism: Corrects asymmetric-tree bias of naive bisection.
IV across clusters + IV within - simplest hierarchical allocation, robustness probe.

axis_D_window_one_at_a_time.mechanism: Responsive but small-sample - tests estimation-noise sensitivity floor.

representation_1_score_level.definition: score_eff = theta*score_core_z + (1-theta)*score_defense_z -> single top-20 EW (production mechanism)

grid.mechanism: Core-tilted - b1 shows recent engine is core.
core_only ablation pole (b1: blend dSR +0.070 vs this).

representation_2_portfolio_level.definition: core top-13 EW portfolio + defense top-12 EW portfolio (13+12<=25 names), combined monthly with weight theta. Sleeve internals fixed EW to isolate the between-sleeve axis.

grid.mechanism: Production ratio at portfolio level (vs score level B03 - representation comparison).

grid.method: inverse-vol (36m rolling monthly sleeve returns, t-1)
grid.mechanism: Sleeve vol equalization - dynamic, no return forecast.
Tail-risk balancing. NOTE: 2-asset ERC is analytically identical to inverse-vol, so ERC is NOT separately registered (honest de-duplication); downside variant registered instead.

grid.method: min-var 2-sleeve (rolling 36m cov incl. correlation), theta_core bounded [0.2, 0.9]
grid.mechanism: Correlation-aware minimum variance - differs from IV when sleeve correlation is high (b1: monthly corr ~0.9).

n_trials_breakdown.baseline_overlap_note: W01(EW) on S1 reproduces b1 blend_65_35 reconstruction except cost model (v2.4 delta vs b1 gross/flat-est) and common-start window - expected small level shift, labeled.

evaluation.rebalance: monthly, month-end score date t -> weights applied month t+1 (harness standard, PIT-verified b0 series)
evaluation.common_start_rule: Per substrate, all methods (incl. EW) evaluated on IDENTICAL rebalance months: first month where the longest cov window (756d) is fully available from RAWDATA daily returns AND substrate scores exist. Expected: S1/S2 ~2005-03 (RAWDATA from 2002-03), S3 ~2008-02 (scores from 2005-02). Apples-to-apples enforced.
metrics_per_trial: PORT_t = portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3 (contract build_benchmark_compare, net active series)
evaluation.comparison_basis: delta vs same-substrate W01 EW baseline on identical months

engine.simulation: 02_Infrastructure/backtest_harness.R::run_monthly_simulation (validated standard engine, cost v2.4_delta default). Portfolio return construction NEVER hand-rolled (no prod/cumprod synthesis).
engine.between_sleeve_combination: Two sleeve portfolios combined via PerformanceAnalytics::Return.portfolio with monthly theta weights (b1 precedent) - no manual (w*r).sum.
engine.stats: build_benchmark_compare for PORT_t on every trial; full build_bt_result (10-component) for IS-selected finalists (max 3: one per axis family) before any graduation claim.
engine.labels: every reported number carries metric_type (backtested via harness on reconstruction/regenerated substrate).

evaluation.alive_criteria_preregistered: Weighting axis declared ALIVE only if some non-EW trial satisfies ALL: (a) IS dSR >= +0.10 vs EW, (b) OOS dSR >= 0 vs EW, (c) dMDD <= +2pp vs EW. Otherwise axis declared CLOSED on validated substrates (negative result, mode-local axiom candidate, INV-7 re-trial complete).
evaluation.runtime_discipline: max 2 concurrent R processes, <=4GB each (Cycle 1 tracks running in parallel)

code_change_allowlist: 1. Local hrp_grid.R under 04_Research/composition_search/cycle1b_trackW/ - sources 02_Infrastructure/portfolio/hrp_core.R, exposes linkage/window/allocation params (calc_hrp_weights currently hardcodes ward.D2 + n_days=120). Infra files NOT modified.
2. NEW algorithm implementations limited to: EWMA(0.94) covariance, HERC allocation, cluster-level IV allocation, vol-scaled EW, 2-sleeve closed-form allocators (B09-B11).
3. Everything else reuses existing harness/advanced_weights/hrp_core/contracts functions verbatim. No edits to 05_Production/, 01_Literature/, 02_Infrastructure/.
